tokens.name: canvas
tokens.usage: Page ground: warm paper in light, indigo night in dark.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Cards, inputs and readable panels on canvas.

tokens.name: surface-subtle
tokens.usage: Grouped info and neutral subpanels.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text on canvas, surface, surface-subtle and every *-subtle tint (15.3:1 on canvas in light).

tokens.name: ink-secondary
tokens.usage: Secondary text and Information status on canvas, surface and surface-subtle (7:1 or more).

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Muted supporting text on canvas, surface and surface-subtle (4.97:1 or more); never for money, times or errors.

tokens.name: border
tokens.usage: Boundaries that identify controls (3:1 or more on every ground).

tokens.name: border-subtle
tokens.usage: Decorative hairlines and dividers only.

tokens.name: indigo
tokens.usage: Adire Indigo, Xenia's one brand colour and the primary action in every mode. 8.71:1 on canvas in light, 9.47:1 in dark.

tokens.name: indigo-hover
tokens.usage: Primary action hover.

tokens.name: indigo-pressed
tokens.usage: Primary action pressed.

tokens.name: on-indigo
tokens.usage: Labels on indigo, indigo-hover and indigo-pressed (9.3:1 or more in both themes).

tokens.name: indigo-subtle
tokens.usage: Selected rows and the quiet secondary-action fill; indigo text reads on it.

tokens.name: indigo-deep
tokens.usage: Inverse surface: stay ticket, money band, footer, app bar on photos.

tokens.name: on-indigo-deep
tokens.usage: Text on indigo-deep.

tokens.name: sand
tokens.usage: Brand-layer highlight on indigo-deep and the photo scrim only (10.5:1 on indigo-deep): eyebrows, the italic headline word on dark. Indigo's complement. Not a mode accent, never on light grounds.

tokens.name: sand-ink
tokens.usage: Sand as text on light grounds: eyebrows and numerals on canvas (5.59:1).

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Focus ring, amber, the complement of indigo: 3px solid with a 2px offset, so it sits on the ground (5.24:1 on canvas in light).

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Confirmed and paid states, always with a check icon and a word.

tokens.name: success-surface
tokens.usage: Success panel ground; success reads at 5.68:1 (light) and 8.03:1 (dark).

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: Deadlines and holds, with a clock icon and the absolute time.

tokens.name: warning-surface
tokens.usage: Warning panel ground; warning reads at 5.31:1 and 8.80:1.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Declines and failures only, never routine expiry. With an icon and a word.

tokens.name: danger-surface
tokens.usage: Danger panel ground; danger reads at 6.38:1 and 6.74:1.

tokens.name: stays-accent
tokens.usage: Stays mode accent (clay, 45°); reaches components only as --mode-accent under [data-mode=stays]. Mark, persona label, selected chips, italic word. Never actions, money or status. 6.31:1 on canvas in light.

tokens.name: stays-subtle
tokens.usage: Stays mode tint (--mode-subtle); ink and stays-accent read on it.

tokens.name: events-accent
tokens.usage: Events mode accent (hibiscus, 350°). 6.56:1 on canvas in light.

tokens.name: events-subtle
tokens.usage: Events mode tint.

tokens.name: community-accent
tokens.usage: Community mode accent (lagoon teal, 190°). 5.76:1 on canvas in light. Replaces the ochre that clashed with brass.

tokens.name: community-subtle
tokens.usage: Community mode tint.

tokens.name: services-accent
tokens.usage: Services mode accent (palm olive, 118°). 5.85:1 on canvas in light.

tokens.name: services-subtle
tokens.usage: Services mode tint.

styles.name: display
styles.usage: Landing hero only; one italic word allowed.

styles.name: money-total
styles.usage: Every total in any mode; Newsreader carries the naira sign. Weight 500, the only upright Newsreader face loaded.

styles.name: h3
styles.usage: Result title: a unit, event, group or service.

styles.name: meta
styles.usage: Secondary status and tags only; never money, times or errors. Weight 400: Hanken Grotesk loads 400, 600 and 700 only.
